scope: Observed regular GRWTSK files, repository-owned Lean files and docs; non-atomic filesystem snapshot; inventory only

filesystem_observation.time: not recorded; no precise observation instant is asserted
filesystem_observation.drift_policy: The live tree may change after observation. Default --check detects live drift; --check-published-snapshot checks the retained report and publication scope.
filesystem_observation.identity_binding: Report identity and input_digests bind the retained observation.

repository_lean_population.untracked_files: excluded in Git mode; included only in non-Git fixture fallback
repository_lean_population.scope: Observed filesystem snapshot of existing regular .lean files, including root modules and fixtures; symlinks excluded. Git mode includes all indexed paths except repository-root .git/ and .lake/, using observed working-tree bytes, not HEAD bytes. Non-Git fallback directory-name exclusions apply only outside GRWTSK/.

legacy_curated_observer_census.scope: legacy curated source paths and pinned-parser observer census

nonclaims: Counts do not establish parsing, elaboration, proof acceptance or theorem admission.
Every regular Lean file under GRWTSK, regardless of directory names, is in the maintained source population; only symlink files and directories are excluded.
Registered object guides and source bindings are curated documentation populations, not whole-library coverage.
The legacy observer census remains historical and is not added to observed filesystem populations.

Physical documentation page counts include every regular Markdown path regardless of directory basename; symlinks are excluded. Curated area-index and write-ownership filters do not remove pages from physical totals.

Pinned publication source counts and source identity are separate from the observed working-tree source populations. Generated article paths are physically counted; the publication generator owns their byte validation.

complete_documentation_publication.source_scope: Every tracked regular .lean Git blob, including GRWTSK library, umbrella and verification support; no namespace exclusion or occurrence cap.

generated_content_inventory.format: SHA-256 of canonical NDJSON {path,byte_count,sha256} in deterministic generation order.
generated_content_inventory.scope: All generated files except this manifest; separate generator --check validates bytes.

complete_documentation_publication.generated_article_body_check: NOT_RUN; complete-documentation generator --check owns byte validation
complete_documentation_publication.curated_object_guide_markers: Generated source issuances are separate from registered curated object guides.
complete_documentation_publication.filesystem_case_policy: Pinned path spellings are preserved; physical directory identity prevents case-alias double counts. Host identities are not published.
